title: relay_queue.rs: dead_dir recomputed three times in drain_once/try_deliver_one
description: self.queue_dir.join('dead') appears three times: in drain_once (line 268) for the dead-letter count, and twice in try_deliver_one (lines 365, 422) for DKIM failure and permanent failure moves. A reader scanning the code may miss that these three sites all refer to the same directory and worry about divergence. SmtpRelayQueue.new() already validates dead/ is writable but never stores the dead_dir path. Simple fix: add dead_dir as a field on SmtpRelayQueue, set in new(), and reuse throughout. Reduces surface for typo-introduced divergence.
